packageRules.description: Refresh rpms.lock.yaml when the base image in argfile-saw.conf changes. The refresh-rpm-lockfiles preset only triggers for the dockerfile manager, and it cannot map an argfile to a lockfile: it matches upgrades to lockfiles by containerfile name, and BASE_IMAGE lives in argfile-saw.conf. Call rpm-lockfile-prototype directly instead. It reads context.containerfile from rpms.in.yaml, resolves the new BASE_IMAGE, and writes rpms.lock.yaml (its default --outfile). This exact command is on the MintMaker allowlist.
